metadata.domain: Autonomous Driving Platform / ADAS / Automotive Electronics

evidence.trl_pathway: All three technologies start at TRL 6-7 and the development timelines (2-3 years) are reasonable for reaching commercial readiness; no unrealistic TRL jumps are required given the relatively mature starting points.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The declared strategy is 시장이익최대 (Market Profit Maximization), which demands near-market, high-TRL technologies completed close to market boom windows, but all three technologies complete significantly after their respective boom periods (1.25–2.0 years late), undermining the profit-capture rationale.
evidence.competitive_awareness: The selected technologies (steer-by-wire, high-voltage connector assembly, camera-ultrasonic integrated sensor) are broadly aligned with the ADAS/automotive electronics domain, but the portfolio lacks depth in differentiating competitive positioning and the high-voltage connector assembly is more manufacturing process-oriented than a core ADAS platform capability.
evidence.market_timing: For 시장이익최대 strategy, technologies should complete within ±0.5 years of their market boom; all three technologies miss this window by 1.25, 1.5, and 2.0 years respectively, representing systematic late-to-market delivery that would significantly erode profit maximization potential.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies have plausible patent-market convergence in the ADAS space, particularly for steer-by-wire and integrated sensors, but there is insufficient evidence that the selections were deliberately chosen based on explicit patent-activity and market-growth convergence analysis.

strengths: All technologies are domain-relevant to Autonomous Driving/ADAS, maintaining coherent portfolio focus
TRL progression plans are realistic with no infeasible development leaps given moderate starting TRL levels
weaknesses: Systematic late completion relative to market boom windows (mean error 1.58 years) fundamentally contradicts the 시장이익최대 strategy objective
Development timelines are too conservative for a profit-maximization strategy — particularly 고전압 커넥터 자동화 조립 taking 3 years from TRL 7
missing_technologies: 차량 사이버보안 (V2X/OTA security) — high-TRL, near-market, strong regulatory tailwind aligned with profit maximization
레이더-카메라 센서 퓨전 SoC — core ADAS platform technology with strong near-term market demand
자율주행 HD맵 실시간 업데이트 — high commercial value with imminent market boom in ADAS deployment
investment_issues: All technologies classified as Strategic or High tier with full budget utilization, but the timing misalignment means investment returns will be suboptimal — capital is being deployed without corresponding market timing discipline
카메라-초음파 통합 센서 receives High tier investment despite lowest strategic fit score (3.0) and largest timing error, suggesting misaligned prioritization
timing_issues: 스테어바이와이어 다중모드 제어 completes 2028-Q1 but boom is 2026-Q4 — 1.25 year late entry means missing first-mover premium
카메라-초음파 통합 센서 completes 2030-Q1 vs boom 2028-Q1 — 2.0 year delay represents the worst timing misalignment; market may be saturated by completion
고전압 커넥터 자동화 조립 development span of 3 years for a TRL 7 process technology is excessively conservative for market profit maximization
